claim_text: Flexible-harness state and handling requirements can depend on deformation, grasping and entanglement/tension management.

supported_conclusion: Deformation-dependent perception, grasp selection, cable separation, tension handling, error detection and entanglement avoidance are evidenced capability dimensions in a related industrial harness task.

claim_text: Electrical connector mating with pose uncertainty can require sensitive/compliant joining and force-guided recovery.
evidence_extract_or_close_paraphrase: Three high-voltage connector types were tested with a robot, two-jaw gripper, flange force/torque sensor and sensitive joining strategies; most in-hand pose deviations were compensated within the tested uncertainty space.
inference_chain: Electrical connector mating experiment → bounded Pack EoL mechanism
supported_conclusion: Compliance/force-sensitive joining is a supported candidate capability for connector mating under defined pose uncertainty.
unsupported_extension_or_transfer_limit: Not a battery Pack EoL setup; the authors warn that transfer to finer-tolerance connectors requires separate examination, and the tested plugs/sockets lacked all electrical connections.
unresolved_evidence_need: Identify target Pack connector geometry, tolerance, supplied pose uncertainty, full electrical configuration and permissible forces
notes: Full-text audit completed; experimental force parameters were empirically selected and must not transfer
